paragraphs.text: Gainwell sells the systems that run state Medicaid programs, tying together claims and encounter management, provider contracts, capitation and member benefits.
paragraphs.quote: Gainwell streamlines Medicaid operations by integrating claims and encounter management, provider contracts, capitation and financial management, and member benefits.

paragraphs.text: Pharmacy is a separate line aimed at medication management and the total cost of care.
paragraphs.quote: Optimizing medication management to lower the total cost of care while improving patient outcomes

paragraphs.text: Another line helps payers avoid and recover improper payments while detecting fraud.
paragraphs.quote: Helping plans avoid and recover improper payments while detecting and preventing fraud.

paragraphs.text: The claims, encounters and financials module is presented as a modernization step built on automation and interoperability.
paragraphs.quote: Gainwell Enterprise ™, our claims, encounters, and financials (CEF) module, supports your modernization journey with intelligent automation and interoperability.

paragraphs.text: An EDI gateway lets providers submit all their claims centrally, which the company says simplifies Medicaid billing.
paragraphs.quote: Gainwell EDI solutions allow providers to submit all their claims centrally, significantly simplifying provider Medicaid billing

paragraphs.text: Its analytics platform is shaped around Medicaid data and federal compliance requirements.
paragraphs.quote: delivers comprehensive data and analytics capabilities for Medicaid programs, providing user-friendly insights and ensuring compliance with federal requirements.

paragraphs.text: Provider management can be modernized in phases with Provider Flex, replaced outright with Provider+, or extended across state lines through a cross-state provider network.
paragraphs.quote: Modernize incrementally with Provider Flex™ , replace legacy systems with Provider+™ or extend your reach across state lines with Provider Everywhere™ , the first cross-state provider intelligence network.

paragraphs.text: The analytics page cites 52 state Medicaid programs.
paragraphs.quote: 52 State Medicaid Programs

paragraphs.text: A case study on the home page covers provider enrollment in Vermont.
paragraphs.quote: Accelerating Provider Enrollment in Vermont

paragraphs.text: That case study claims an 87.5% reduction in enrollment processing time.
paragraphs.quote: 87.5% Reduction in Enrollment Processing Time

paragraphs.text: Its centralized credentialing platform is described as NCQA accredited.
paragraphs.quote: Reduce provider burden and administrative cost through a shared, NCQA-accredited, and scalable centralized credentialing platform.

paragraphs.text: The company points to longstanding experience keeping Medicaid programs running with accurate data for decision making.
paragraphs.quote: Our longstanding experience ensures that your Medicaid program runs efficiently, with accurate data for decision-making, better provider reimbursement, and enhanced beneficiary care.
